response.justification: Bogdan is a genuinely senior/staff-level engineer with 15+ years of shipping production software across web, backend, mobile and embedded, and he has recent, directly relevant exposure to agentic tooling (MCP code generators and agent-infrastructure frameworks at re:cinq). However, the core AI requirement — 8+ years building production AI solutions, RAG architectures, vector databases, and data pipelines for structured/unstructured data — is essentially unmet; his GenAI experience appears to be roughly one year and infrastructure-adjacent rather than model- or retrieval-centric. Python is absent from his stack and cloud depth is limited to AWS CDK usage. He could be a strong hire for an FDE role if the team values engineering breadth, customer-facing craft and rapid ramp-up over pre-existing GenAI depth, but he is below bar as written for a Staff GenAI specialist.
strengths: 15+ years senior/staff engineering with strong TypeScript, Node.js and distributed systems experience
Hands-on MCP and agentic workflow tooling experience, plus founder-level ownership of an open-source platform
Proven mentoring, workshops, conference talks and TDD/CI craftsmanship — fits customer-facing technical leadership
concerns: No demonstrated RAG, vector database, or LLM evaluation/optimization experience
Python not listed; AI experience appears to be ~1 year, far short of the 8-year requirement
Limited evidence of large-scale data pipelines for unstructured data or deep cloud architecture on AWS/GCP/Azure

key_factors.factor: Missing RAG / vector DB / production AI depth
Staff-level engineering breadth and delivery track record
